verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a public API reference with concrete endpoints for building quotes and creating session tokens, plus webhooks, a test mode and sandbox, an OpenAPI-based codegen guide, and an llms.txt for agent-friendly docs, so the core of driving the product programmatically is covered. Much of the documented surface is the browser Web SDK and hosted frames rather than raw API calls. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI spec reachable at standard paths (the probe returned 404 on all candidate paths), broader evidence of endpoint coverage beyond quotes and sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
